src: Cedar Rapids Gazette, 20 Oct 1914, p. 14 (Newspapers.com 551860243): new $83,000 city reservoir 'on Kelly's Island [sic]'

tw-il-eureka-onnen-henhouse.st: The note was pencilled on the back of a 1937 calendar. His obituary calls him Henry 'Bunker' Onnen, 65, 62 years at Minonk, dead alone in 'the family home'.
tw-il-eureka-onnen-henhouse.t: The 'family home' where he died is the target; its location is not yet fixed.
